title: C1: Exit check: polynomial rings over integral domains
title_html: C1: Exit check: polynomial rings over integral domains
html: Let R be a commutative ring. Prove @thm-degree-of-product (a) and (b) (for (b), the equivalence, the leading coefficient, and the case of no zero divisors), and then prove @cor-polynomial-no-zero-divisors (a) and (c).
